title: A check that does two things

provenance.authoredBy: Mentor (drafted with AI assistance, positions engine-verified)

steps.title: Check plus attack
steps.body: A check forces a reply, so a second attack goes unanswered. This is the idea behind most forks.

wrong.default: Look for a check that also attacks something.

steps.onSuccess: Nd6+ checked the king and attacked the rook on c8, so the rook fell.

steps.why: A forced reply gives you a free second threat.

solution: The opponent must reply to them.
